bibliographic.title: Hallucination Detection and Mitigation in Large Language Models

relevance_to_mlgg: Operational framework for hallucination management in regulated environments, demonstrated on financial data extraction. Directly analogous to MLGG's medical metadata extraction pipeline.
key_methods: Continuous improvement cycle for hallucination management
key_findings: Root causes categorized into model, data, and context factors
Uncertainty estimation effective for detection in structured extraction
Knowledge grounding reduces hallucination in domain-specific extraction
Systematic methodology scales to regulated environments
actionable_for_mlgg: Adapt continuous improvement framework for extract_paper_metadata.py
Implement uncertainty estimation (confidence scoring) per extracted field
Apply knowledge grounding: cross-reference extracted values against known paper databases
